response.rationale: Both Malay forms correctly mean “bride,” and the English cue and sense are aligned. However, “different-common-word” overstates the contrast: pengantin perempuan is also used in Indonesian, while pengantin wanita is understandable in Malaysian. No false-friend contrast is present or needed.
